title_working: A Giant Tsunami Is Coming. Where Would You Hide?

lines.text: A giant tsunami is coming. Where would you hide?
lines.say: (nervous) A giant tsunami is coming. Where would you hide?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You only have seconds to choose.
lines.say: (nervous) You only have seconds to choose.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Option one: a big beach house with food, power and soft beds.
lines.say: (happy) Option one: a big beach house with food, power and soft beds.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But the wave will smash the windows and flood every room.
lines.say: (nervous) But the wave will smash the windows and flood every room.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Option two: a tall apartment building a few blocks back. You are high above the street.
lines.say: (happy) Option two: a tall apartment building a few blocks back. You are high above the street.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But if the water reaches it, there is nowhere left to run.
lines.say: (nervous) But if the water reaches it, there is nowhere left to run.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Option three: a secret bunker deep inside a mountain, with endless food, a gaming room and a private pool.
lines.say: (happy) Option three: a secret bunker deep inside a mountain, with endless food, a gaming room and a private pool.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The wave can never reach you there.
lines.say: (confident) The wave can never reach you there.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But to pick the bunker, you have to subscribe and comment which one you chose.
lines.say: (happy) But to pick the bunker, you have to subscribe and comment which one you chose.
lines.speaker: narrator
